`travel.xls` is a synthetic test workbook generated for kist. It contains a
merged title, Chinese text, formatted numeric values, a cached SUM formula,
and a second sheet with 110 rows and 33 columns. It was written as XLSX with
Excelize and converted to Excel 97–2003 format with LibreOffice. It contains
no user data and is distributed under the repository's Apache-2.0 license.
